name: Premium Straight Feather Flags
descriptionHtml:
Make a bold and professional statement with our Premium Straight Flags, designed for clean, vertical branding at trade shows, outdoor events, storefronts, festivals, and canopy displays. The straight-edge design offers a modern, structured look that keeps your message clear, readable, and impactful from a distance.

Available in 9ft, 12ft, and 15ft sizes, all straight flags are double-sided by default, ensuring your branding is visible from both sides. Your artwork is printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on premium knitted polyester fabric for vibrant colors and long-lasting performance.

Each flag includes a cross base and water bag as standard, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments. For added versatility, you can upgrade to ground stakes or a canopy mounting kit, allowing the flag to be securely mounted directly onto a canopy tent.

Built with strong yet flexible fiberglass poles, these flags are lightweight, durable, and easy to set up—perfect for vendors who need reliability and professional presentation.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Straight Flag Design – Clean, vertical shape for maximum readability
📏 Available Sizes – 9ft, 12ft, and 15ft
🔁 Double-Sided Printing Included – Standard on all flags
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, fade-resistant graphics
💪 Fiberglass Poles – Lightweight, flexible, and durable
⚓ Base Included – Cross base + water bag included
🏕️ Multiple Mounting Options – Optional ground stakes or canopy mounting kit
🧳 Portable & Easy Setup – Fast assembly for events and promotions

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Graphic / Flag: Knitted Polyester
🦾 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass
🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, vendor booths, canopy tents, storefront advertising, festivals, promotions, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
